infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Ultra-Clear uses your location to show nearby experience centres and water refill ATMs.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ultra-Clear uses your camera to attach photos to maintenance tickets.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Ultra-Clear accesses your photo library to attach photos to maintenance tickets.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Ultra-Clear reads your contacts so you can invite friends to join and earn referral rewards.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Ultra-Clear to access your contacts to invite friends and earn referral rewards.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Show current location on the map.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Ultra-Clear to access your photos for maintenance tickets.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Ultra-Clear to take photos for maintenance tickets.
